mapper.select: SELECT id, title, slug, summary, cover_image, raw_cover_image, status, is_pinned, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM posts WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (title, slug, summary, content_md, cover_image, raw_cover_image, status, is_pinned, view_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{slug}, #{summary}, #{contentMd}, #{coverImage}, #{rawCoverImage}, #{status}, #{isPinned}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
